definitions.explanation: The hard covering at the tip of human fingers and toes.
The sharp curved nail of an animal or bird.

examples.japanese: {爪|つめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びてきた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
{爪|つめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マニキュア→マニキュア：19400_manikyua⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I put nail polish on my nails.

examples.japanese: ⟦{爪切|つめき}り→爪切り：05287_tsumekiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please lend me the nail clippers.
I was injured by a bear's claws.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{爪|つめ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{切|き}らなければならない→切る：02693_kiru⟧。

notes:
{爪|つめ} refers to fingernails, toenails, and animal claws/talons.
